findings.title: Medical sources warn of continued reduction in number patients and wounded permitted to leave Gaza
findings.location: Gaza Strip; medical departures from Gaza (crossing not independently verified)
findings.affected_population_system: Patients and wounded awaiting external medical evacuation; accompanying caregivers
findings.supporting_passage: The medical sources stated that only 22 people—patients and their companions—were granted permission to travel today, Tuesday.
findings.source_type: Official Palestinian news agency reporting unnamed local medical sources, not a first-party WHO or crossing authority confirmation

discovery_context.evidence: 17 Nov medical sources said only 22 people, including companions, permitted to depart that day; evacuation waiting lists exceed 21,000 cases, and sources claim outbound permissions linked to returnees from Egypt.
discovery_context.independent_corroboration: Not located in bounded searches or accessible WHO global/OCHA pages.
discovery_context.limitations: 22 is combined patients and companions, not patient-only count. Identity of medical sources, formal policy documentation, actual departures, crossing location, and counterparty response not independently verified. The report confirms a newly dated restriction datapoint, not necessarily a newly implemented policy.

supplementary_direct_checks.detail: Direct news index and related-story links inspected; WAFA English medical-evacuation report published 14:19 Palestinian local time on 17 November.
Direct current index inspected; matching Arabic medical-evacuation report published 14:09 local time, same underlying claims as English edition.

17 November morning Deir al-Balah/al-Maghazi reported demolitions: prior watch already captured.

Previous 12 November Nasser Hospital strike and general Gaza health capacity data: historical, not newly qualifying.
limitations: WHO Eastern Mediterranean regional site timed out; this is a continuing known source gap, not a newly material degradation.
WAFA medical-source claim is anonymous and not independently verified by WHO/OCHA; interpreted conservatively as reported claim rather than confirmed change in evacuation policy.
Direct index checks show source publication times in Gaza/Palestine local time; America/Los_Angeles used for watch dates and bounds.

coverage_notes.overall: One new, dated medical-evacuation access datapoint discovered; pre-existing WHO regional fetch timeout keeps run DEGRADED, with accessible WHO global/OCHA alternatives. One durable heartbeat recorded.
